note: Each entry is located in a captured file of this package: the blog page fetched logged out (text extracted from the saved html), the public game clients fetched logged out, and the verifiers the games link to, saved from CodePen. found = true means the exact text is present or the comparison holds.

entries.claim: The FortuneJack blog lists Plinko and Keno among the titles on a 99% theoretical RTP
entries.quote: Dice, Mines, Plinko, Crash, Keno, Limbo, Hi-Lo, and Baccarat run on a 99% theoretical RTP.

entries.claim: The blog equates 99% RTP with a 1% house edge
entries.quote: A 99% RTP corresponds to a 1% theoretical house edge.

entries.claim: The blog's own example: $10,000 in stakes, about $100 kept
entries.quote: $10,000 in total stakes, the mathematical model retains approximately $100

entries.claim: The Plinko game rules state a 1% house edge (rules text in the public client)
entries.quote: Every drop is provably fair and can be verified. House edge: 1%.

entries.claim: The Keno game rules state no RTP or house-edge figure (rules text in the public client)
The FortuneJack Plinko game links this public verifier
entries.note: set by the game's own configuration (gameId fj.plinko), which replaces the default verifier link in the shared client code at startup

entries.claim: The FortuneJack Keno game links this public verifier
entries.note: set by the game's own configuration (gameId fj.keno), which replaces the default verifier link in the shared client code at startup

entries.claim: The Plinko verifier the game links holds the same 27 payout tables as the live game
The Keno verifier the game links holds no payout table
Both verifiers compute outcomes the way the replay in this package does

plinko: slot += nextInt(2, serverSeed, clientSeed, startNonce + i)
keno: const j = i + nextInt(balls.length - i, serverSeed, clientSeed, nonce);
